items.headline: Gundy breaks silence, 'excited' for resurgent Oklahoma State
items.description: On the day the No. 18 Cowboys defeated UCF 42-28 to improve to 4-1, former Oklahoma State coach Mike Gundy made his debut on TNT Sports on Saturday, addressing his firing more than a year later while also expressing his excitement for this year's team.

items.headline: No. 18 Oklahoma State surges past UCF 42-28 after a fumble-return turning point
items.description: — Drew Mestemaker threw for 304 yards and two touchdowns, Evan Jackson returned a fumble 28 yards for another score, and No. 18 Oklahoma State pulled away from UCF in the second half for a 42-28 win Saturday.
